clips.title: The story
paras: At Dreadmist Peak, druids seek tainted water in an empty Cenarion vessel. The sample may help diagnose and cure the blight spreading among wildlife in the northern Barrens.

Dendrite Starblaze suspects the pools atop Dreadmist Peak are at the heart of a sickness afflicting gazelles and unsettling the northern Barrens. The pools influence the weather, and the druid fears they are tied to the spreading blight. He sends druid initiates with empty samplers to brave the mountain heights and draw water from the peak. The Burning Blade, a demon-worshipping cult, now infests the mountain.
